# Explore Restland Cemetery
Founded in 1925 as a beautifully landscaped park northeast of downtown Dallas, we began with a mission to celebrate life and serve families. So we planted trees, created pathways and nurtured our community. There is much joy to be found here, and we invite you to find yours. Explore more. Take a tour. Share in experiences.

**Non-denominational, non-sectarian chapel.** In 1942 the Wildwood Chapel was constructed based on the simple theory of a typical countryside chapel. Nestled at the heart of Restland Memorial Park under a beautiful treed canopy. Wildwood Chapel is non-denominational and non-sectarian, its only theology is love and its congregation is the whole world. Wildwood Chapel has a seating capacity of 75 people and is equipped with audio visual capabilities that will make any service memorable.

**Located within the Abbey Mausoleum.** Abbey Mausoleum Chapel was created to host intimate gatherings with a capacity of 75 people. The chapel is the center point of our large indoor mausoleum. This chapel boasts soaring ceilings and marble & wood lined corridors. This chapel is equipped with audio visual capabilities that will make any service memorable.
